input.title: [Mobile] Share button on Mobile Chrome and Safari downloads the content
input.body: ## Step to Reproduce 1. Open em on Mobile Safari or Chrome 2. Create a new thought 3. Tap Export button on the toolbar menu 4. Tap Share button ## Current behavior Thought content is downloaded. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a270fa95-5853-4f02-bf23-c31459377de0 ## Expected behavior Share button should open Share dialog follow the Capacitor user flow
